name: Gray Orc
traits: Medium Humanoid (Orc). +2 Strength, −2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, −2 Charisma. Land speed 40 ft.
Proficient with the greataxe and longbow.
Light Sensitivity (Ex) gives −1 on attack rolls in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell.
Scent (Ex). Detect creatures by smell at 30 ft. in still air, 60 ft. upwind and 15 ft. downwind. Use a move action to determine direction. Pinpoint a scent source within 5 ft.
A character with Track can follow a scent trail using Survival. A fresh trail typically has DC 10, increasing by 2 per hour.
Orc Blood. Counts as an orc for racial effects and items.
Common and Orc are automatic. Bonus languages are Draconic, Giant, and Goblin.
Favored class Cleric. No racial Hit Dice. Level adjustment +1 gives ECL 2 at the first class level.
This 3.5 profile uses the printed attack-only Light Sensitivity and core Scent rules. The Gray Orc player entry does not grant darkvision.
